title: PMVS v1 record envelope
description: Machine shape for PMVS records, attestations, and storage locations. The prose rules and selected profile schemas define their meaning.

uint.$comment: uint256; the PMVS verifier also rejects values greater than 2^256 - 1

positiveUint.$comment: positive uint256; the PMVS verifier also rejects values greater than 2^256 - 1

decimalsMax18.$comment: decimals capped at 18; the annex fee math requires accounting-asset decimals D <= 18, and backend/settlement/1 pins 18-decimal shares

sint.$comment: signed 256-bit integer; the PMVS verifier enforces the exact two-sided range

admin.$comment: null means no dedicated proxy-admin getter; it does not prove that implementation resolution or storage is immutable

checks.$comment: Items must be strictly ascending by id; duplicate ids are invalid.

continuingWatcherHeads.$comment: Items must be strictly ascending by unsigned streamId; duplicate streamIds are invalid.

migration.$comment: The PMVS verifier recursively rejects transactionHash, txHash, blockHash, blockNumber, transactionIndex, txIndex, and logIndex anywhere in a components record's open objects. Future activation locators are post-action evidence.

venueState.$comment: The selected venue profile supplies and closes every other property.

supersedesUnexecuted.$comment: The PMVS verifier binds a non-null value to the latest unresolved, receipt-less, registry-anchored pre-action record for the same subject and epoch, across either branch. The named record must have an earlier stream sequence and an earlier priceAttempt.

The PMVS verifier binds a non-null value to the latest unresolved, receipt-less, registry-anchored pre-action record for the same subject and epoch, across either branch. The named record must have an earlier stream sequence and an earlier priceAttempt.

retirementResolution.$comment: This object records evidence of a resolution completed before the finalization transaction. The wrapper does not consume it as an instruction. Beneficiary nullability is action- and profile-dependent. The PMVS verifier checks the action, beneficiary, canonical evidence, timing, and completion.

retirementRecovery.$comment: Subject retirement cannot leave an open or migrated recovery right. A resolved manifest records pre-finalization evidence that the wrapper does not consume as calldata. The PMVS verifier proves that the manifest is exhaustive and that every named right was resolved before the finalization transaction.

residualPositions.$comment: Entries disclose completed pre-finalization resolutions that the wrapper does not consume as instructions. An empty array claims that no nonzero residual position required resolution. The PMVS verifier proves completeness against the custody perimeter.

residualCash.$comment: Entries disclose completed pre-finalization resolutions that the wrapper does not consume as instructions. An empty array claims that no nonzero residual cash balance required resolution. The PMVS verifier proves completeness against the custody perimeter.

migration.$comment: Core v1 retirement-final is subject-only. Component generation replacement uses a components migration before retirement.
